ROUND 1 — STRUCTURE

Grey boxes, real numbers, one type weight. No colour or type decisions yet — those are round 2.

Run the five-second test BEFORE tapping anything: open A, then B, five seconds each. Can you name (1) which muscles are under-stimulated, (2) which adaptations are untouched, (3) whether to push today?

Write the answer down. Then start tapping.

FORK 1 — where readiness sits

A: readiness GATES the local read. One instruction, never two. On a bad day the gap is dimmed.

B: readiness sits ALONGSIDE. The gap is never hidden; you combine the two signals yourself.

Second question, answered differently in each: the six whole-body qualities get ONE combined read in A, ONE STATE EACH in B.

FORK 2 — when the capture control exists

The same fork three times: always-visible quick-add (T1) vs revealed-on-intent (T2). Both work on all three artboards — tap them.

Water is logged daily. Donation three times a year. Body weight twice a month. One answer has to cover all three, and it decides three folds at once.

THE TIERS

T1 — on screen the moment Home paints. This is the entire five-second answer and nothing else. Ships in the initial chunk.

T2 — appears when the read raises a question: a drill-in, a detail, an inline capture. Lazy chunk, prefetched on hover.

T3 — reached by an explicit destination change. Lazy chunk, no prefetch.

If the glance needs a tap, T1 is wrong. If every chart is in T1, the bundle is wrong.

PLACEHOLDERS

Every physiological threshold on this canvas is marked PLACEHOLDER and is NOT decided:

· 60 sets per muscle per cycle
· recovered after 48 h
· 3.0 L hydration target
· donation windows 14 / 56 days
· the readiness push threshold

/ground runs before any of these becomes code.
